name: Mere Humdam
overview: Warda is an honest and hardworking young girl who is trying to stand on her own two feet. In her professional life, she meets Usama, and over time, a strong relationship develops between the two. However, in this environment, people with different mindsets, like Haris, also emerge, causing Warda to face conflicts between social classes and familial expectations. This drama is based on strong family relationships, the theme of a love triangle, and individual growth, which makes “Mere Humdam” a unique drama.
